description: This file defines Express.js routes for session tracking, including GET endpoints with caching, ETag handling, tenant resolution, and cache invalidation on CRUD operations.

methods.name: roundToMinuteISO
methods.description: Rounds a date string to the start of the minute in ISO format.

methods.name: cacheKeyFromReq
methods.description: Generates a cache key string based on request query parameters and enforced tenant.

methods.name: cacheGet
methods.description: Retrieves a cached response if valid, otherwise null.

methods.name: cacheSet
methods.description: Stores a response in cache with an associated ETag.

methods.name: invalidateAllSessionTrackingCache
methods.description: Clears all session tracking related cache entries.

methods.name: computeETag
methods.description: Computes a SHA1 hash as ETag based on payload and context.

methods.name: sessionsEarlyBypassDetector
methods.description: Middleware to detect early tenant bypass conditions based on headers and query parameters.
